sources.title: Llama 3.1 Nemotron Safety Guard 8B v3 model card
sources.evidence: Names NVIDIA and the exact v3 Llama-derived safety model; publishes 8.03B total, Transformer architecture, 8K context, text-to-JSON moderation and current license terms. Current release-date line is October 28, 2025.

sources.title: Exact v3 NVIDIA NIM model card
sources.evidence: Separately dates Hugging Face release August 1, 2025 and Build/NGC October 28, 2025; gives 8.03B, up to 8K context, nine languages and 23 safety categories.

sources.title: Exact v3 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM; 32 layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 14336, 32 attention heads and eight KV heads of dimension 128; vocabulary 128256, untied embeddings, BF16, no projection biases or quantization; max_position_embeddings 131072.

sources.title: Exact v3 merged BF16 checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps 291 learned weight tensors to four shards; total tensor bytes 16060522496. Header names exactly match this index, with no extras or omissions.

sources.title: Exact v3 BF16 shard 1: tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP Range read of the eight-byte header length and JSON header only (9520 bytes total) found 82 BF16 learned weight tensors containing 2488344576 parameters; no scale tensors, buffers, packed tensors or adapter tensors.

sources.title: Exact v3 BF16 shard 2: tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP Range read of the eight-byte header length and JSON header only (12128 bytes total) found 104 BF16 learned weight tensors containing 2499895296 parameters; no scale tensors, buffers, packed tensors or adapter tensors.

sources.title: Exact v3 BF16 shard 3: tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP Range read of the eight-byte header length and JSON header only (11664 bytes total) found 100 BF16 learned weight tensors containing 2457952256 parameters; no scale tensors, buffers, packed tensors or adapter tensors.

sources.title: Exact v3 BF16 shard 4: tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP Range read of the eight-byte header length and JSON header only (568 bytes total) found 5 BF16 learned weight tensors containing 584069120 parameters; no scale tensors, buffers, packed tensors or adapter tensors.

sources.title: Exact v3 causal language generation example
sources.evidence: Loads AutoModelForCausalLM and calls model.generate to decode safety JSON. The classification task is implemented through autoregressive text generation, not a sequence-classification head.

sources.title: CultureGuard technical report, version 4
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies the released final CultureGuard model as Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Safety-Guard-8B-v3. Section 3.3 describes Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct LoRA training with rank 8 and alpha 32. Tables distinguish this model from prior Safety-Guard-V2 and other reasoning models; no active-parameter count is defined.

sources.title: October 17 model card with exact v3 name
sources.evidence: This historical primary card already names Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Safety-Guard-8B-v3 and explicitly gives August 26, 2025 as release date, preceding the later NIM launch.

sources.title: October 28 Nemotron and Safety Guard v3 launch announcement
sources.evidence: October 28, 2025 announcement introduces Safety Guard v3, nine languages and 23 moderation categories, downloadable weights, NVIDIA NIM availability and NeMo Guardrails integration.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement
sources.evidence: Agreement permits use, modification and distribution subject to its terms; exact model card separately identifies the additional Llama 3.1 Community License.

sources.title: Exact v3 tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Inherited Llama chat template contains tools and tool_calls branches and model_max_length 131072, but no thinking-mode template. This syntax alone does not establish tool-calling proficiency after the safety fine-tune.

sources.title: Separately distributed LoRA adapter configuration
sources.evidence: CAUSAL_LM LoRA adapter for meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: rank 8, alpha 32, targets q_proj and v_proj. Separate adapter is an alternative to the merged checkpoint, not an additional component of it.

sources.title: Separate LoRA adapter tensor header
sources.evidence: A 16944-byte header-only range census found 128 F32 low-rank weight tensors containing 3407872 parameters. They are excluded from the merged checkpoint total.

sources.title: Current v3 repository tree and checkpoint continuity
sources.evidence: Compared tree metadata for the four safetensors shards at current revision, October 17 e85652ef382441d5acb1577466d741314bf671ba, and August 23 dd2ec523d8ec5d3af03bd1a3b7e9b1656777164a: all four shard objects are identical. The August card used the former Multilingual-8B-v1 name; this is verified repository continuity, not transfer from an unrelated earlier model.

sources.title: August card for the same checkpoint under its former name
sources.evidence: August 23 card calls this checkpoint Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Safety-Guard-Multilingual-8B-v1 and explicitly dates release August 26, 2025; later renamed in the same repository without changing its four weight shards.

sources.title: Current Safety Guard v3 model card, reopened October 27
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved October 27, 2026. Explicitly reports 8.03B model parameters and identifies Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the base. Describes PEFT with rank 8, alpha 32, q_proj/v_proj LoRA and separately distributed adapters; no pruning, expert expansion or new modality is described. The published nominal total agrees with the retained previously verified merged-checkpoint total.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 18: exact Llama 3.1 8B Instruct activated count
sources.evidence: Table 18 explicitly identifies LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and lists 8B under # Activated Params, separately from # Total Params. This is the Qwen research team's nominal benchmark convention for the named base model, not an NVIDIA disclosure for Safety Guard v3. NVIDIA's documented LoRA lineage supports transferring the nominal convention as a labeled inference.

sources.title: Jamba-1.5: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Models at Scale, ICLR 2025 Table 1
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded the full original proceedings PDF and read Table 1 (PDF page 5). It independently lists Llama-3.1 8B with 8B Available params and 8B Active params. This corroborates the nominal AI21 comparison convention; Table 18 of Qwen3 more specifically names the Instruct checkpoint used by NVIDIA.

name.note: Exact v3 variant; normalize publisher hyphenation to the catalog display name.

developer.note: NVIDIA developed this safety fine-tune; Meta developed its Llama base.

family.note: NVIDIA markets this model in the Nemotron family.

release_date.note: Earliest release month supported by explicit primary release dates and unchanged-checkpoint continuity. NVIDIA NIM says Hugging Face August 1; the October 17 exact-v3 card and August card say August 26. Preserve month precision because the day conflicts. October 28 is the later Build/NGC launch and current-card date. Repository creation and paper submission were not used as release evidence.

open_weights.note: Public original merged BF16 weights and a separate LoRA adapter; tensor headers were retrieved without authentication.

license.value: NVIDIA Open Model License + Llama 3.1 Community License
license.note: Exact model card names the governing NVIDIA agreement and additional Llama 3.1 license; API trial and NIM container licenses are separate.

parameters_b.note: Retain the previously verified merged-checkpoint total of 8.030261248B; the freshly reopened NVIDIA card independently publishes the compatible nominal count 8.03B. The separate LoRA adapter is an alternative distribution, not an additional component of the merged model. This pass did not request weight shards or repeat the earlier tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 8B active is a labeled lineage inference. Qwen3 Table 18 explicitly reports 8B activated parameters for the exact Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct base; AI21 Jamba-1.5 Table 1 independently gives Llama-3.1 8B an 8B active count. NVIDIA's card and CultureGuard section 3.3 document LoRA fine-tuning of that named base. Freshly reopened model and adapter configurations retain the Llama architecture, q_proj/v_proj LoRA and no layer replication; no pruning, routed experts or new modalities were found. Transfer the research teams' nominal convention through this unchanged lineage. NVIDIA does not separately publish an exact Safety Guard v3 active count; LoRA trainable parameters are not the active count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Llama Transformer with grouped-query attention and dense gated MLPs. Checkpoint has a full language-model head, no routed experts or classifier head. Generates moderation JSON autoregressively.

context_window.note: Use the exact safety model cards' advertised up-to-8K context, represented as 8192 tokens. Inherited config/tokenizer allow 131072 positions; that architectural capacity is not evidence that this safety fine-tune is supported or validated at 128K. Baseline 128000 conflicts with the specialized cards.

modalities.note: Text conversations produce JSON text through causal generation. Build card has a stray Video input-format entry, but its input type, exact HF card, config and inference code all establish text-only operation.

reasoning.note: The documented safety task emits direct JSON; the exact card, inference example, tokenizer and technical report do not describe dedicated reasoning training or a thinking control. This supports the documented moderation interface but does not establish a model-wide negative capability claim. Clear the unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact safety documentation specifies moderation JSON, not function calls; however the inherited tokenizer includes tool-call syntax. Neither positive nor categorical negative capability is established for this fine-tune, so clear the baseline false rather than infer capability from the base model or template.

description.value: Open-weight Llama 3.1 safety fine-tune that generates JSON assessments of prompts and responses across nine languages and 23 safety categories.
description.note: Replace unsupported risk-aware-routing wording with documented scope; retain this autoregressive safety model in the catalog.

patch.license: NVIDIA Open Model License + Llama 3.1 Community License
patch.description: Open-weight Llama 3.1 safety fine-tune that generates JSON assessments of prompts and responses across nine languages and 23 safety categories.
patch.notes: NVIDIA publishes nominal 8.03B; the previously verified merged-checkpoint total is 8.030261248B. Nominal active 8B follows the Qwen team's explicit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct comparison count, corroborated by AI21, and is inferred through NVIDIA's documented LoRA lineage. NVIDIA does not separately disclose an exact active count. Separate LoRA weights are not added to the merged total. Cards advertise 8K moderation context, although inherited config/tokenizer permit 131072 positions. Earliest release month is August 2025: primary sources disagree between August 1 and August 26; October 28 is the later NIM/Build launch. Same four checkpoint shard objects were verified before and after its rename from Multilingual-8B-v1. This causal LM generates safety JSON; tool-calling capability is unresolved despite inherited template syntax. Dedicated reasoning support is not established by the safety documentation.

parameter_count_validation.method: For each indexed safetensors shard, HTTP Range bytes=0-7 yields little-endian uint64 header length; bytes=8-(7+length) yields JSON header. Require HTTP 206 and exact requested length. Exclude __metadata__, sum product(shape), verify name set equals index, and inspect all names/dtypes for non-parameters. No whole weight shard was downloaded.
parameter_count_validation.tensor_inventory: Each of 32 layers: q/o [4096,4096], k/v [1024,4096], gate/up [14336,4096], down [4096,14336], two norm [4096]; plus untied embedding and lm_head [128256,4096] each, final norm [4096]. All 291 entries are learned weights.
parameter_count_validation.adapter_exclusion: Separate lora_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors has 128 F32 tensors, 3407872 parameters, header bytes 16944. Do not add to already-merged model. Formula: 32*8*((4096+4096)+(4096+1024)).

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains the previously verified 8.030261248B merged total, freshly corroborated by NVIDIA's nominal 8.03B disclosure. Establishes nominal active 8B as an explicit lineage inference from Qwen3 Table 18's exact Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct activated count, corroborated by AI21 Jamba-1.5 Table 1. Reopened NVIDIA's current card, CultureGuard v4, model configuration and adapter configuration; these document LoRA training of the named base without a structural change that defeats the nominal inference. NVIDIA's exact derivative-specific active count remains unpublished. Preserves the other twelve field assessments and earlier release/context/capability qualifications. No weight shards were requested and no tensor census was performed in this pass.
